name: Ten Keys
tagline: Agree on the split. Then launch.
description: Ten Keys is a counting room for creator fees: set up to ten shares, check that they add up to 100%, and seal the sheet before launch. It runs in your browser. $TENKEYS on Solana.

hero.text: pump.fun lets a creator send fees to up to 10 wallets. Ten Keys is the counting room. Set the shares. Check the sum. Seal the sheet. Then launch.

split.title: Counting room
split.lead: A fee split calculator. Up to ten recipients. It runs in your browser and connects to nothing.

labels.holderNote: Holders get the sheet without the site tag, two splits side by side and a table file. This switch is a preview. It checks nothing.
labels.sheetAlt: The sealed split sheet: roles, shares and the seal code
labels.shareNote: X opens with the text ready. Attach the downloaded sheet to the post yourself.
labels.notContract: Not a contract. Shares are set on pump.fun by the creator.
labels.private: Runs in your browser. Nothing is uploaded. No wallet is connected.

split.shareText: {n} keys. 100%. Sealed {code}. Agree on the split. Then launch. $TENKEYS

howToBuy.title: Get a wallet
howToBuy.text: Install Phantom or Solflare from the official website or app store.

howToBuy.title: Get some SOL
howToBuy.text: Buy SOL on an exchange and send it to your wallet.

howToBuy.title: Open pump.fun
howToBuy.text: Connect your wallet and paste the $TENKEYS contract address.

howToBuy.title: Swap for $TENKEYS
howToBuy.text: Choose the amount and confirm the swap. One transaction. Done.

rules.title: Rules
items: The sheet is not a contract. It is a record of what the team agreed.
The counting room does not set or move fees. Shares are set on pump.fun by the creator or the community admin.
Rules on pump.fun can change. Check the live form before launch.
Everything is calculated in your browser. Nothing is uploaded. No wallet is connected.
Holder preview is a switch, not a check. The wallet check is not built.
The seal code shows that two sheets have the same content. It proves nothing else.
